value.name: Auxiliary Shields Team
value.text: [Repair]: You may treat the maximum shield values of your right and left hull zones as increased by 1 when you recover or move shields to those zones. If you do, the number of shields in those zones cannot exceed a maximum of "4".

value.name: Engine Techs
value.text: [Navigate]: After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to execute a 1-speed maneuver.

value.name: Fighter Coordination Team
value.text: After you execute a maneuver, you may select a number of unengaged friendly squadrons up to your squadron value at close-medium range. Those squadrons may move up to distance 1.

value.name: Medical Team
value.text: Before you are dealt a faceup damage card with the Crew trait, you may discard this card to discard that damage card.

value.name: Nav Team
value.text: [Navigate]: Your [Navigate] tokens can either change your speed or increase your yaw value by 1.

value.name: Projection Experts
value.text: [Repair]: You may spend up to 2 engineering points to move that many shields from your ship to a friendly ship at distance 1-5.

value.name: Auxiliary Shields Team
value.text: [Repair]: You may treat the maximum shield values of your right and left hull zones as increased by 1 when you recover or move shields to those zones, to a maximum of 4.
